pairs: These things the Lord has revealed to me.
And behold, a hook to draw down fruit.
And the Lord said to me,
Venit finis super populum meum Israël;
“The end has come for my people Israel.
non adjiciam ultra ut pertranseam eum.
I will no longer pass through them.”
Et stridebunt cardines templi in die illa,
And the hinges of the temple will creak in that day,
Silence will be thrown away in all places.
and who make those in need of land to do without.
“When will the first day of the month be over,
so we can sell our wares,
so we can open the grain:
in order that we may decrease the measure,
in order that we may possess the destitute with money,
and the poor for a pair of shoes,
and may sell even the refuse of the grain?”
The Lord has sworn by the arrogance of Jacob:
Si oblitus fuero usque ad finem omnia opera eorum.
I will not forget, even to the end, all their works.
Numquid super isto non commovebitur terra,
Will not the earth shudder over this,
and all rise up like a river,
and flow away like the river of Egypt?
And it will be in that day,
that the sun will decline at midday,
et tenebrescere faciam terram in die luminis:
and I will cause the earth to become dark on the day of light.
et convertam festivitates vestras in luctum,
And I will turn your feasts into mourning,
et omnia cantica vestra in planctum,
and all your hymns into lamentation.
et inducam super omne dorsum vestrum saccum,
And I will put sackcloth over every one of your backs,
et ponam eam quasi luctum unigeniti,
And I will begin it like the mourning for an only-begotten son,
et novissima ejus quasi diem amarum.
and complete it like a bitter day.
dicet Dominus, et mittam famem in terram:
says the Lord, and I will send a famine on the earth:
but for hearing the word of the Lord.
Et commovebuntur a mari usque ad mare,
And they will move even from sea to sea,
et ab aquilone usque ad orientem:
and from the North all the way to the East.
They will wander around seeking the word of the Lord,
and they will not find it.
In die illa deficient virgines pulchræ et adolescentes in siti,
In that day, beautiful virgins, and young men, will fail because of thirst.
They swear by the offense of Samaria,
and they will not rise up any more.
